Package dev.opencollab.paletter.annotation

Annotation Interface BedrockExperiment

@Documented @Retention(RUNTIME) @Target(TYPE) public @interface BedrockExperiment
Marks a component for which the Minecraft creator docs name an experiment toggle ("Upcoming Creator Features" and the like), in some format versions. The toggle id is the one the captured Bedrock Dedicated Server gives that name; see the constants of BedrockExperiments, and enable one with VanillaContent#experiments(String...).

The gating comes from the docs. Where a BDS capture of the component in a world without experiments exists, the component's Javadoc says BDS-verified and for which builds it holds; without one it says unverified against BDS.

This is separate from Experimental: that one means the Paletter API itself may change.

Since:
1.0.0
